name: Fugl-Meyer Assessment
description: Comprehensive clinician-administered scale for post-stroke motor recovery. Separate UE (0–66), LE (0–34), and total motor (0–100) subscores.
copyright: Free for non-commercial use (U. Gothenburg); cite Fugl-Meyer 1975
shirleySays: ICC 0.97–0.99 (excellent inter-rater). FMA-UE MDC: ~5.2 pts (chronic stroke); MCID: 9–13 pts (acute-subacute). Core measure recommended by Stroke Recovery and Rehabilitation Roundtable for ALL stroke trials. Administration time ~30–35 min for full version.
